{{nihongo|'''Araki Shrine'''|荒城神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Hida Province]].

'''Araki Shrine''' (あらきじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located in {{ill|Takayama, Gifu|Q622594|qid=Q622594}}, {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|ace|Prefektur Gifu|af|Gifu-prefektuur|an|Prefectura de Gifu|ar|غيفو (محافظة)|arz|جيفو (محافظه)|az|Gifu prefekturası|azb|قیفو اوستانی|ban|Préféktur Gifu|be|Гіфу (прэфектура)|bg|Гифу|bn|গিফু প্রশাসনিক অঞ্চল|ca|Prefectura de Gifu|cdo|Gifu-gâing|ce|Гифу (префектура)|ceb|Gifu-ken|ckb|پارێزگای گیفو|cs|Prefektura Gifu|cy|Gifu (talaith)|da|Gifu-præfekturet|de|Präfektur Gifu|eo|Gubernio Gifu|es|Prefectura de Gifu|et|Gifu prefektuur|eu|Gifu (prefektura)|fa|استان گیفو|fi|Gifun prefektuuri|fr|Préfecture de Gifu|frr|Gifu (Prefektüür)|ga|Maoracht Gifu|gl|Prefectura de Gifu|hak|Gifu-yen|he|גיפו (מחוז)|hr|Gifu (prefektura)|hu|Gifu prefektúra|hy|Գիֆու (պրեֆեկտուրա)|id|Prefektur Gifu|ilo|Prepektura ti Gifu|it|Prefettura di Gifu|ja|岐阜県|jv|Préfèktur Gifu|ka|გიფუს პრეფექტურა|kn|ಗಿಫು (ಪ್ರಾಂತ್ಯ)|ko|기후현|lt|Gifu prefektūra|lv|Gifu prefektūra|mk|Гифу (префектура)|mni|ꯒꯤꯐꯨ ꯂꯝꯈꯥꯢ|mr|गिफू प्रांत|ms|Wilayah Gifu|ne|गिफु|nl|Gifu (prefectuur)|no|Gifu (prefektur)|nov|Gifu Prefekture|os|Гифу (префектурæ)|pam|Prepektura ning Gifu|pl|Prefektura Gifu|pnb|ضلع گیفو|pt|Gifu|ro|Prefectura Gifu|ru|Гифу (префектура)|se|Gifu prefektuvra|sh|Prefektura Gifu|simple|Gifu Prefecture|sk|Gifu (prefektúra)|sr|Префектура Гифу|su|Préféktur Gifu|sv|Gifu prefektur|sw|Mkoa wa Gifu|tg|Префектураи Гифу|th|จังหวัดกิฟุ|tl|Prepektura ng Gifu|tr|Gifu (prefektörlük)|tt|Гифу (префектура)|uk|Префектура Ґіфу|ur|گیفو پریفیکچر|vi|Gifu|war|Gifu (prefektura)|wuu|岐阜县|zh|岐阜县|zh_classical|岐阜縣|zh_min_nan|Gihu-koān|zh_yue|岐阜縣|qid=Q131277}}.

It is a {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=listed shrine in the Engishiki Jinmyōchō}} and one of the eight shrines in {{ill|Hida Province|Q1056535|qid=Q1056535}} listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}. Under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=former shrine ranking system}}, it was classified as a prefectural shrine. The main hall is designated as a national {{ill|Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Q1188622|qid=Q1188622}}<ref>{{Cite web|Japanese book|date= |url=https://bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/185256 |title=Araki Shrine Main Hall |publisher={{ill|Cultural Heritage Online|Q105237617|qid=Q105237617}}/{{ill|Agency for Cultural Affairs|Q1009519|qid=Q1009519}} |accessdate=2021-06-26}}</ref>. The main hall was also recognized in 2016 as part of the {{ill|Japan Heritage|Q18382798|qid=Q18382798}} designation “The Skills and Spirit of the Hida Craftsmen / Medieval Shrine and Temple Architecture Group of the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Kokufu Basin}}”<ref>{{Cite web|Japanese book|date= |url=https://japan-heritage.bunka.go.jp/ja/stories/story029/ |title=Japan Heritage Portal Site: The Skills and Spirit of the Hida Craftsmen|publisher=Agency for Cultural Affairs |accessdate=2019-02-21}}</ref>.

At the autumn grand festival held every year on September 7, the “Araki Shrine Kaneuchi and Lion Dance” (designated as an Important Intangible Cultural Property of Gifu Prefecture) is performed<ref>{{Cite web|Japanese book|date= |url=http://www.pref.gifu.lg.jp/kyoiku/bunka/bunkazai/17768/mukei-minzoku/arakijinnjya.html |title=Araki Shrine Kaneuchi Lion Dance |publisher=Gifu Prefecture |accessdate=2016-02-06}}</ref>. Since 2016, the autumn grand festival has been held on the first Sunday of September.

The area surrounding the shrine is a well-preserved green space mainly composed of {{ill|Cryptomeria|Q147388|qid=Q147388}}, and it has been designated as a Green Environment Conservation Area (designated on September 30, 1977)<ref>{{Cite web|Japanese book|url=https://www.pref.gifu.lg.jp/page/6062.html|title=List of Green Environment Conservation Areas|publisher=Gifu Prefecture|date=|accessdate=2024-10-19}}</ref>.

=== History ===
Although the founding date is generally unknown, the {{ill|jinjameisaichou|Q11590704|qid=Q11590704}} states that “its founding dates back to ancient times.” The {{ill|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|Q1052981|qid=Q1052981}} records that on October 5, {{ill|Jōgan|Q1075635|qid=Q1075635|lt=Jōgan}} 9 ({{ill|867|ab|867|af|867|am|867 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|867|ar|867|ary|867|ast|867|avk|867|az|867|azb|۸۶۷ (میلادی)|bcl|867|be|867|be_x_old|867|bg|867|bn|৮৬৭|bpy|মারি ৮৬৭|br|867|bs|867.|ca|867|cdo|867 nièng|ceb|867|ckb|٨٦٧|crh|867|cs|867|csb|867|cv|867|cy|867|da|867|de|867|el|867|eml|867|eo|867|es|867|et|867|eu|867|fa|۸۶۷ (میلادی)|fi|867|fo|867|fr|867|frr|867|fy|867|ga|867|gan|867年|gd|867|gl|867|he|867|hi|867|hr|867.|ht|867 (almanak jilyen)|hu|867|hy|867|id|867|ilo|867|io|867|is|867|it|867|ja|867年|jv|867|ka|867|kaa|867|kk|867 жыл|ko|867년|la|867|lb|867|lij|867|lmo|867|lt|867 m.|lv|867. gads|map_bms|867|mdf|867|mg|867|mhr|867|mk|867|mr|इ.स. ८६७|mrj|867 и|ms|867|mzn|۸۶۷|nah|867|nap|867|nds|867|new|सन् ८६७|nl|867|nn|867|no|867|nrm|867|nso|867|oc|867|or|୮୬୭|os|867-æм аз|pl|867|pnb|867|pt|867|qu|867|ro|867|ru|867 год|rue|867|sa|८६७|scn|867|sd|867ع|se|867|sh|867.|shn|867|si|867|sk|867|sl|867|smn|867|sq|867|sr|867|su|867|sv|867|sw|867|tg|Соли 867|th|พ.ศ. 1410|tk|867|tl|867|tly|867|tr|867|tt|867 ел|uk|867|ur|867ء|uz|867|vec|867|vi|867|war|867|wuu|867年|xmf|867|zh|867年|zh_min_nan|867 nî|zh_yue|867年|qid=Q30347}}), during the reign of Emperor Seiwa, “Araki no Kami of Hida Province was granted Junior Fifth Rank.” From the {{ill|Muromachi period|Q334845|qid=Q334845}} onward, it was known as Kawahaku Daimyōjin, but during the {{ill|Bunka|Q1373146|qid=Q1373146|lt=Bunka}} of the Edo period, investigations determined that it was Araki Shrine.

On July 1, {{ill|1952|Q5272|qid=Q5272}} (Shōwa 27), it was designated by the Gifu Prefecture Association of Shinto Shrines as a shrine to be visited by the chief priest of the prefectural association ({{ill|Kinpei-sha|ja|金幣社|qid=Q119929592}}), designation No. Kin-7{{sfn|Kimura|1997|p=173}}.

=== Major Cultural Properties ===
{{Special characters|target=section|description=In “three-bay nagare-zukuri with kokera roofing,” the second character from the back (kokera) uses a character with the wood radical and “market.” It resembles 【柿】 (kaki, persimmon) but is a different character.}}
; {{ill|Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Q1188622|qid=Q1188622}} (National designation)
* Main Hall – The current main hall, designated as a National Important Cultural Property building, was constructed in {{ill|1390|Q6375|qid=Q6375}} ({{ill|Genchū|Q1146236|qid=Q1146236}} 7). This three-bay nagare-zukuri hall with kokera roofing was designated in Meiji 42 ({{ill|1909|ab|1909|af|1909|als|1909|am|1909 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1909|ar|1909|ary|1909|arz|1909|ast|1909|av|1909|avk|1909|az|1909|azb|۱۹۰۹ (میلادی)|ba|1909 йыл|ban|1909|bar|1909|bat_smg|1909|bcl|1909|be|1909|be_x_old|1909|bg|1909|bh|1909|bn|১৯০৯|bpy|মারি ১৯০৯|br|1909|bs|1909.|ca|1909|cdo|1909 nièng|ce|1909 шо|ceb|1909|ckb|١٩٠٩|co|1909|crh|1909|cs|1909|csb|1909|cv|1909|cy|1909|da|1909|de|1909|diq|1909|dsb|1909|el|1909|eml|1909|eo|1909|es|1909|et|1909|eu|1909|ext|1909|fa|۱۹۰۹|fi|1909|fiu_vro|1909|fo|1909|fr|1909|frp|1909|frr|1909|fur|1909|fy|1909|ga|1909|gag|1909|gan|1909年|gcr|1909|gd|1909|gl|1909|gn|1909|gv|1909|hak|1909-ngièn|he|1909|hi|१९०९|hif|1909|hr|1909.|hsb|1909|ht|1909 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1909|hy|1909|hyw|1909 թուական|ia|1909|id|1909|ig|1909|ilo|1909|inh|1909 шу|io|1909|is|1909|it|1909|ja|1909年|jv|1909|ka|1909|kaa|1909|kbp|1909|kk|1909 жыл|kn|೧೯೦೯|ko|1909년|krc|1909 джыл|ksh|Joohr 1909|ku|1909|kv|1909-ӧд во|kw|1909|la|1909|lb|1909|lez|1909 йис|li|1909|lij|1909|lmo|1909|lt|1909 m.|lv|1909. gads|mai|१९०९|map_bms|1909|mdf|1909|mg|1909|mhr|1909|mi|1909|min|1909|mk|1909|ml|1909|mn|1909 он|mr|इ.स. १९०९|mrj|1909 и|ms|1909|my|၁၉၀၉|myv|1909 ие|mzn|۱۹۰۹|nah|1909|nap|1909|nds|1909|new|ई सं १९०९|nl|1909|nn|1909|no|1909|nov|1909|nrm|1909|nso|1909|oc|1909|olo|1909|or|୧୯୦୯|os|1909-æм аз|pa|1909|pam|1909|pap|1909|pl|1909|pms|1909|pnb|1909|pt|1909|qu|1909|ro|1909|roa_tara|1909|ru|1909 год|rue|1909|sah|1909|sc|1909|scn|1909|sco|1909|sd|1909ع|se|1909|sh|1909.|shn|1909|simple|1909|sk|1909|sl|1909|smn|1909|sq|1909|sr|1909|srn|1909|stq|1909|su|1909|sv|1909|sw|1909|szl|1909|ta|1909|te|1909|tg|Соли 1909|th|พ.ศ. 2452|tk|1909|tl|1909|tly|1909|tpi|1909|tr|1909|tt|1909 ел|ty|1909|udm|1909 ар|ug|1909 - يىلى|uk|1909|ur|1909ء|uz|1909|vec|1909|vi|1909|vls|1909|vo|1909|wa|1909|war|1909|wuu|1909年|xmf|1909|yi|1909|za|1909 nienz|zea|1909|zh|1909年|zh_classical|一九〇九年|zh_min_nan|1909 nî|zh_yue|1909年|qid=Q2057}}) as a Specially Protected Building under the {{ill|Ancient Temples and Shrines Preservation Law|Q11411552|qid=Q11411552}} (designated as a “National Treasure” under the {{ill|National Treasures Preservation Law|Q11420716|qid=Q11420716}}, later reclassified as an “Important Cultural Property” under current law). In Shōwa 38 (1963), seven ridge plaques were additionally designated as attached Important Cultural Properties.

; {{ill|list of Gifu Prefecture Designated Cultural Properties|Q11471459|qid=Q11471459|lt=Prefectural Important Cultural Properties}}
* Araki Shrine deity statues (2 figures)<ref>{{Cite web|Japanese book|date= |url=http://www.pref.gifu.lg.jp/kyoiku/bunka/bunkazai/17768/cyoukoku/mokuzouaraki.html |title=Araki Shrine Deity Statues |publisher=Gifu Prefecture |accessdate=2016-02-06}}</ref>
* Guardian figures (2 figures)<ref>{{Cite web|Japanese book|date= |url=http://www.pref.gifu.lg.jp/kyoiku/bunka/bunkazai/17768/cyoukoku/mokuzouzuisinn.html |title=Zuishin |publisher=Gifu Prefecture |accessdate=2016-02-06}}</ref>
* Waniguchi gong (1)
* Masks (4)<ref>{{Cite web|Japanese book|date= |url=http://www.pref.gifu.lg.jp/kyoiku/bunka/bunkazai/17768/kougei/takayama-mask.html |title=Masks |publisher=Gifu Prefecture |accessdate=2016-02-06}}</ref>

; Prefectural Important Tangible Folk Cultural Property
* Lion heads (9 items)<ref>{{Cite web|Japanese book|date= |url=http://www.pref.gifu.lg.jp/kyoiku/bunka/bunkazai/17768/yukei-minzoku/araki.html |title=Araki Shrine Lion Heads |publisher=Gifu Prefecture |accessdate=2016-02-06}}</ref>

; Prefectural Historic Site
* Araki Shrine Site – From the shrine grounds, four {{ill|Jōmon period|Q52824|qid=Q52824}} dwelling remains have been discovered, along with Jōmon {{ill|Earthenware|Q1377111|qid=Q1377111}} (Middle to Late Jōmon) and {{ill|Stone tool|Q479257|qid=Q479257}} (chipped {{ill|stone axe|Q1540412|qid=Q1540412}}, {{ill|stone arrowhead|Q11587274|qid=Q11587274}}, polished stone axes, stone swords, {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=stone crowns}}, stone plates, etc.). The site has been designated as a Gifu Prefecture Historic Site under the name “Araki Shrine Site”<ref>{{Cite web|Japanese book|date= |url=http://www.pref.gifu.lg.jp/kyoiku/bunka/bunkazai/17768/siseki/arakijinnjya_24971.html |title=Araki Shrine Site |publisher=Gifu Prefecture |accessdate=2016-02-06}}</ref>.

=== Enshrined Deities ===
* Principal deities
** Ōaraki no Mikoto (13th-generation descendant of {{ill|Takamimusubi|lt=Takamimusubi|UNKNOWN|qid=Q125400|lt=Takamimusubi no Mikoto}})
** Kunimizu Kokuwake no Kami
** Mitsuhanome no Kami
* Subsidiary shrines
** Akiba Shrine
** Inari Shrine
** Tsushima Shrine
** Araki Shrine

=== Access ===
* About 5 km from {{ill|Hida-Kokufu Station|Q5357911|qid=Q5357911}} on the {{ill|Takayama Main Line|Q1188357|qid=Q1188357}} of {{ill|Central Japan Railway Company|Q513679|qid=Q513679|lt=JR Central}}
* About 15 km (25 minutes by car) from {{ill|Takayama interchange|Q11669304|qid=Q11669304|lt=Takayama IC}} on the {{ill|Chūbu-Jūkan Expressway|Q11367325|qid=Q11367325}}
